message: ２年Ｂ組金髪先生

name: Misa
message: 「Onee-samaaa~~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
The instant I stepped out of the new school building's entrance on my way to the Student Council room, Misa closed in on me.
And then came to a sudden halt.

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why is it you, Sakura-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What kind of answer are you expecting to that question?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up, I'm being serious here」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I was waiting here to accidentally bump into Onee-sama by chance or anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「You just gave away the answer」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, there are hundreds of people inside the school building, you know? Isn't the probability of Ria-senpai and you colliding practically zero?」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no need to worry about that. I happen to be very lucky.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really, now?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, really! Just look at me--I'm only a quarter foreign, yet I have blonde hair!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's true」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's natural blonde, you know? Not dyed」

name: Synn
message: 「I can tell just by looking」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen here. Do you have any idea how astronomically low the genetic probability is for someone who's a quarter foreign to be born blonde?」

name: Misa
message: 「In other words, good fortune is practically guaranteed for me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, even assuming what you say is true, Misa... why would you bump into Ria-senpai?」

name: Misa
message: 「I finally managed to become Vice President of the Student Council... and even had a Rosary bestowed upon me, yet the distance between Onee-sama and me hasn't closed in the slightest.」

name: Misa
message: 「At a time like this, there is only one breakthrough! A fateful accident that suddenly brings the two of us closer together!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now, enough chit-chat. According to my statistics, Onee-sama should be coming out right about now!」

name: Synn
message: 「At that point, probability and luck have nothing to do with it--isn't that just a staged incident?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-She's here!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaun♪」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm so sorry, how clumsy of me! Are you hurt at all, Onee-sama?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not a scratch?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mugyo!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm quite alright, dear. What about you, Vice President? Did you scrape yourself anywhere?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... I'm fine...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...Well, seeing as you broke your fall like it was all scripted, I'm sure you're perfectly lively」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, good day to you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Whisper, whisper... By the way, I had Ria head over to the old school building from the east gate, so wouldn't she be in the Student Council room right about now?」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Grin」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee, farewell then」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh... Shall we head to the Student Council room, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-She saw right through me? Misasagi-senpai, of all people? Could it be that I used up all my luck simply by being born blonde?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The moment you lost the election to Master Synn, your luck was already rotten, Hisa?」

name: Misa
message: 「The match isn't over yet!!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, it's not too late even now. I'll defeat Sakura-kun and become Student Council President!」

name: Misa
message: 「If I do that, I'm sure to be blessed with Onee-sama's favor... Prepare for a showdown, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... That's completely absurd logic, are you sure you're okay, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr! Like I said, stop treating me like some pitiful kid!」
While soothing and coaxing Misa, I somehow make my way toward the Student Council room……
